variants.prompt: On a plush, velvet chaise in a dimly lit, antique-filled boudoir, Clara reclines, one leg bent at the knee, the other extended along the cushions, her Victorian-style corset and shorts leaving little to the imagination, a macro lens zooms in on the intricate lace trim of her corset as she looks up at the camera with a sultry, half-lidded gaze, the soft light and shadows accentuating the curves of her body.
